ينتقيا (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِيَا (yantaqiyā) /jan.ta.qi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# يُنْتَقَيَا (yuntaqayā) /jun.ta.qa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
